name: Now Playing
description: Control Spotify or Apple Music from Orca: now playing, controls, your albums and library, search, queue and devices, in the sidebar. On a Mac it works with no setup; connecting Spotify adds your library, Albums and Queue.

settings.title: Spotify Client ID
settings.description: The Client ID of your own app at developer.spotify.com. The app needs the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback. The panel walks you through it.

cover.alt: Now Playing in Orca's sidebar: a song with its cover art, the device menu open with volume, and the Library with Liked Songs, DJ and daylist

screenshots.alt: Three panels: the Library with Made for you and playlists, search results for lantern, and the Queue
